text: よし　おしえる　ポケモンを　えらんでくれ

structure.jp: おしえる　ポケモンを

patterns.name: 〜てくれ
patterns.explanation: てくれ after a verb is a blunt, manly way of asking someone to do something for you. えらんでくれ = 'pick one for me'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: おしえる　ポケモン
patterns.explanation: A verb placed right before a thing describes that thing. おしえる　ポケモン = 'the Pokémon (I will) teach'.
